name: @paw/electron
description: PAW Electron — a desktop shell that runs pawd in-process and shows the live @paw/gui console. Owns no domain logic.

scripts.start: npm run build:gui && npm run build && electron dist/main.cjs --root=../cli/test/fixtures --config=ready.config.json
scripts.capture: npm run build:gui && npm run build && electron dist/main.cjs --root=../cli/test/fixtures --config=ready.config.json demo.swarm.mjs --capture
